# CSS 分发包 · CSS Distribution

> 由 `npm run build:css` 生成。产物刻意不压缩，不要手改。
> Generated by `npm run build:css`. Intentionally unminified; do not edit by hand.

- `wenxin.css`：完整 kit，不含形态 token。
- `wenxin-f1.css` … `wenxin-f9.css`：完整 kit + 对应形态 token；F9 同时包含 F4 印刷阶梯。

All imports are flattened. Relative font URLs are rebased to `kit/base/fonts/`, so the bundles can
be linked directly while retaining self-hosted, unicode-ranged font delivery.
